<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="0.42" stop-color="#263636"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#728887" stop-opacity=".34"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".65"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="15"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="390" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="426" rx="165" ry="190" fill="#000000" opacity=".27" filter="url(#soft)"/>

  <!-- restrained automotive-style decorative arcs -->
  <path d="M-24 227 Q91 102 207 133 Q314 161 414 65" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".13" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M-50 250 Q79 119 211 153 Q322 182 430 75" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".09" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M-18 640 Q98 530 207 559 Q318 589 416 486" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".11" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M-26 665 Q98 554 215 586 Q321 616 421 512" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".07" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M24 790 Q126 705 216 731 Q302 754 369 696" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".09" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M17 814 Q129 727 222 755 Q307 780 381 716" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".06" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <rect x="318" y="20" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="323" y="17" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="328" y="14" width="3" height="14" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="333" y="11" width="3" height="17" rx="1"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7">
    <path d="M345 20 Q351 14 357 20"/>
    <path d="M348 23 Q351 20 354 23"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="351" cy="26" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="365" y="16" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="387" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="368" y="19" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- centered brand -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="319" r="57" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".95"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="319" r="49" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".08" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".34" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="195,274 201,307 228,296 207,319 228,342 201,331 195,364 189,331 162,342 183,319 162,296 189,307" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="319" r="7" fill="#728887" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="411" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nobile, serif" font-size="30" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF">Mercedes-Benz</text>
    <line x1="120" y1="431" x2="270" y2="431" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".55" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="458" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">THE BEST OR NOTHING</text>
  </g>

  <!-- loading indicator -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="535" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M195 517 A18 18 0 0 1 212 529" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="580" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">Preparing your experience</text>
  <rect x="128" y="602" width="134" height="3" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".2"/>
  <rect x="128" y="602" width="76" height="3" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- bottom navigation/action row -->
  <rect x="15" y="737" width="360" height="91" rx="29" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".12" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- home -->
  <g transform="translate(48 758)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polygon points="0,12 13,1 26,12"/>
    <rect x="5" y="11" width="16" height="14" rx="2"/>
    <line x1="13" y1="16" x2="13" y2="25"/>
  </g>
  <text x="61" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8">Home</text>

  <!-- vehicle -->
  <g transform="translate(112 759)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polyline points="2,19 6,9 22,9 26,19"/>
    <rect x="1" y="18" width="26" height="8" rx="3"/>
    <line x1="7" y1="13" x2="20" y2="13"/>
    <circle cx="7" cy="27" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="21" cy="27" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="125" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8">Vehicle</text>

  <!-- prominent center action -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="775" r="31" fill="#728887" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="775" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="762" x2="195" y2="788" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="182" y1="775" x2="208" y2="775" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF">Start</text>

  <!-- notifications -->
  <g transform="translate(251 758)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="3" y="7" width="20" height="17" rx="8"/>
    <polygon points="7,24 11,24 9,28"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="7" r="3.5" fill="#7EC0F6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <text x="264" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8">Updates</text>

  <!-- account -->
  <g transform="translate(319 758)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
    <circle cx="13" cy="8" r="6"/>
    <ellipse cx="13" cy="23" rx="11" ry="6"/>
  </g>
  <text x="332" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8">Account</text>
</svg>
